comment:
Owner: finish the Space Needle in full. Keep everything that reads (saucer, halo, orange band, dome, spire, SkyLine, core with
glass elevators and the gold car, Pavilion) and the plot and height. Fix:
1. THE WAIST. The legs taper but barely pinch, so the hourglass, the Needle's signature, is lost. Reshape the six legs (three
   pairs) so that from the feet (about 40 apart across) they lean in to a pronounced narrow WAIST at about y 120 where each
   pair comes within about 6-7 blocks of the centre axis (hugging the core), then flare back OUT to meet the saucer's
   underside at about 14-16 from the centre. Seen from any side, the silhouette must be a clear hourglass, as in
   /Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/mc-design-eval/benchmarks/plugin-baseline/runs/build-1/sf-landmarks/refs/space-needle/04-legs-and-waist.jpg and /Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/mc-design-eval/benchmarks/plugin-baseline/runs/build-1/sf-landmarks/refs/space-needle/01-whole-tower.jpg. Keep the horizontal ties between legs every ~12 blocks.
2. STAIRS. The "Stairs and ladders" part placed nothing: add the emergency stair inside the core from the Pavilion to the
   SkyLine and on up to the saucer (a stacked switchback of stairs and slabs, or ladders inside the lattice), so every level
   is reachable on foot.
3. LIGHT IT. "Lights and details" placed only 12 blocks: light the core, every leg tie, the SkyLine soffit, the saucer's
   underside ribs and decks, and the Pavilion so no mob can spawn anywhere (hidden glowstone/sea lanterns, lanterns), and add
   a ring of uplights at the feet. The beacon at the spire's tip stays.
4. HALO. From below the halo reads as a solid ring: open it up to read as radiating fins with sky between them (every other
   fin removed or thinned, an outer rail kept).
Nothing may leave its plot.
summary:
Legs reshaped into a strong hourglass: feet still 22 from the centre, waist at y120 now 6.5 (was 8), flaring back out to 14 under the saucer, with all ties kept.
A spiral emergency stair in smooth quartz stairs now climbs the core shaft from the Pavilion through SkyLine to both saucer floors (it takes the old ladder's place); all 5 rooms are walkable.
Lighting: 512 sea lanterns (v1 had 155): ground uplights and a ground grid, core posts, every pair tie, Pavilion floor and roof, SkyLine rim, under-saucer ribs, decks, halo, roof steps and dome; no dark cell anywhere.
Halo: 45 fins every 8° instead of 90, and the solid floor rim under them removed, so sky shows between the fins from below; top hoop and iron-bar rail kept.
applied: 1 WAIST: one leg-curve formula, used in all three helper files, now gives R = 6.5 + 15.5·t^1.15 below y120 and 6.5 + 7.5·u^1.4 above. Feet stay at R 22 (about 44 across), the waist is R 6.5 at y120 (hugging the core), and the legs reach R 14 at y205 under the saucer. I checked that no leg cell enters the core or the elevator shafts. The step stairs, pair ties every 12 and radial ties still come from the same code. All four elevation renders now read as a clear hourglass.

2 STAIRS: parts/stairs.mjs builds a spiral stair round the 16-cell ring of the core's 5x5 shaft, rising one block per cell from y2 to y218. It lays the shaft floors at y42, 212 and 218 and keeps 3 blocks of headroom over every step. The spiral is timed so that the north core doorways stay clear at every floor. The ladder is gone; the stair uses its cells. The walk check reaches the Pavilion, SkyLine, the Loupe and both observation decks.

3 LIGHT: ground uplights in a ring at r 25 round the feet plus a flush grid every 8 blocks (ground minimum light 6); sea lanterns in the core corner posts every 12; a lamp in the middle of every pair tie; Pavilion floor and roof rings; SkyLine floor rim (its soffit and roof lamps were already there); lamps in the underside ribs at r 16, 22 and 28; extra restaurant and deck floor rings; a lamp at the foot of every halo fin; a lamp grid in the roof steps and dome; a lamp in each shaft floor. Room light minimums: Pavilion 6, SkyLine 8, Loupe 4, both decks 3, with 0 dark cells. The spire beacon is unchanged.

4 HALO: fins cut from every 4° to every 8° (45 fins). The y212 floor now stops at r 27, so the r 28–30 band is open underneath and the fins run down to y212. The top hoop at y222 and the iron-bar mid rail at r 30 are kept. A view from below shows sky between the fins.
skipped: I replaced the core ladder with the spiral stair rather than keeping both. They need the same cell (32,34), and you offered either option.

The new stair leaves 3 floor cells open at SkyLine (y42) and 6 at the saucer floors (y212, y218), where the stair passes up through them. The build log shows these as refused writes from the SkyLine and saucer parts. That is expected.

Some leftovers I did not fix: the structure check flags the flush ground lamps at y0 as unsupported (they are full blocks set into the stone, so I believe this is wrong), and it still counts about 166 orphans, mostly radial-tie slabs (v1 had 161). The palette check's flags (light-on-light white, the gold car and orange band called outliers) are left as they are because they are the design. The deck light minimum is 3: dim, but no spawning.
